about: The B1 findings (chemcore/findings/B1.md) and the compared quantities each covers; farm/tests/test_b1.py fails on a disagreement no finding covers and on an open finding that no longer disagrees. Every finding is decided for ours (owner amendment B5): golden v1 stays the reference; the test still fails on any new disagreement.

B1-02.title: A CO2 a DIC cannot hold: the source answers its search end (pH 0), ours no pH

B1-03.title: Borders beyond the source's search range are clamped (NH3 to 12, H2S to 3.0 / 13.5)

B1-04.title: Reagent molar masses: the source's 3-decimal values against ours from the atomic weights

B1-05.title: A base with CO2 stripping gives no recipe in the source (WQ-40)

B1-06.title: The source's simulator clamps DIC and alkalinity at 0 (WQ-41)

B1-07.title: The source's safe zone ignores H2S and can cross itself (WQ-30)
